n0.insight:

[from n7] Spectral quotient coefficients must themselves be compiled from the original cells; bounded-frontier elimination is constructive, but the dense all-order excursion parameters remain uncompiled.

n6.insight: A nonbacktracking determinant resums Gaussian loops exactly. Incompatible occupations require further correction; restricted failed formulas do not rule out a different joint representation.
